The user wants to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234 as soon as possible and check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport, travel_to last airport, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to provide estimated total payable amount. But what about booking? They want to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234. We might need to cancel existing booking? Or just compute cost? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234 as soon as possible, and want to check different options." So maybe they want to book a new flight? But they mention booking ID 1234. Possibly they want to cancel or modify? The user wants to compute cost. So we need to get flight cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. But we also need to authenticate? The user didn't provide credentials. We might need to call get_flight_cost. That doesn't require authentication. So we can call get_flight_cost with travel_from, travel_to, travel_date, travel_class. That returns cost. Then we can provide estimated total payable amount. But do we need to consider insurance? Not mentioned. So just cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost. Then respond with estimated total payable amount. Also mention that we can proceed to book flight if needed. But we don't have card id or access token. So we can't book. So we just provide cost.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
